name: ANSI/IEEE terminal connection symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for terminal connection, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The round terminal form identifies a connection point in the vendor's IEEE-oriented library. Terminal identity and wire-number conventions tell the reader whether it is a physical terminal, a diagram connection reference or another declared interface.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Use the terminal plan to resolve physical position.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A terminal mark is different from a wire-junction dot when the drawing assigns it a physical connection identity.
